name: MutSel
title: Fitness modifier with state-specific fitnesses
description:
Modify an input mutation rate matrix using a fitness for each state (each codon for a codon alphabet). This is a model component, not a complete codon model. The construction GTR +> x3 +> MutSel +> dNdS gives FMutSel with default arguments. Replacing x3 with MNM extends the mutation model to include multinucleotide changes.

Stationary inputs produce stationary models, whether reversible or not.

Non-equilibrium inputs retain their root frequencies.

citation.title: Mutation-Selection Models of Codon Substitution and Their Use to Estimate Selective Strengths on Codon Usage
